title: E-commerce Platform & Fulfillment System
description: Led a team of six in building a comprehensive e-commerce platform with integrated fulfillment processes, leveraging modern web technologies and agile methodologies.
content_markdown:
## Overview

As Senior Developer at Offpriced Canada Inc., I led a team of six developers in establishing a complete e-commerce platform and its fulfillment process.

## Key Responsibilities

### Team Leadership

- Managed a cross-functional team of 6 developers
- Utilized Notion for effective progress tracking
- Conducted daily stand-up calls
- Implemented Kanban board for task tracking

### Technical Architecture

- Pioneered scalable web applications using Python
- Ensured high performance and maintainability
- Employed Git for version control

### Platform Features

- Full e-commerce storefront with product catalog
- Shopping cart and checkout system
- Order management and fulfillment tracking
- User account management with security protocols

## Technology Stack

- Backend: Python, Django
- Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Version Control: Git
- Project Management: Notion
